## Summary

Describe the user-visible result and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build:plugin`

## Compatibility and risk

Describe affected MCP hosts, tool-surface changes, cache/migration behavior and
security implications.

## Checklist

- [ ] No credentials, personal data or local-only artifacts are included
